title: 更即時掌握新版，手動檢查不必等待
summary: 預覽版每小時自動檢查更新，連線失敗會較早重試，手動檢查取消固定冷卻時間。
highlights: 啟動後保留 30 秒緩衝，預覽版每小時、正式版每天檢查，近期成功檢查過便跳過。
連線失敗先於 5 分鐘後重試，持續失敗逐步延長至每小時，重開後仍保留重試進度。
手動檢查完成後可立即再試；同一時間共用一個請求，遇 GitHub 限流仍顯示可再次檢查的時間。
usage: 開啟新版 SnapBar，在「關於與支援」保留「自動檢查更新」勾選即可；需能連線 GitHub，也可隨時按「檢查更新」。下載與安裝仍由使用者手動完成。

en.title: Find updates sooner without a manual cooldown
en.summary: Preview builds check hourly, failed connections retry sooner, and manual checks no longer have a fixed cooldown.
highlights: Keep the 30-second startup buffer; preview builds check hourly and stable builds daily, skipping recent successful checks.
Retry connection failures after five minutes, gradually backing off to hourly retries and preserving progress across restarts.
Check again immediately after completion. Concurrent checks share one request; GitHub rate limits still show when checking can resume.
en.usage: Open the new SnapBar and leave automatic checks enabled under About & Support. GitHub connectivity is required; you can also use Check for updates at any time. Downloading and installing updates remain manual.
